database_summary: This is a baseball historical/statistical dataset (Lahman-like) in SQLite. It contains player, team, park and college reference tables plus season-level and event/award-level statistics for batting, pitching, fielding, postseason, awards, salaries and appearances. Many tables are seasonal (year +/- stint), some are postseason/round aggregates, and several are voting/award event tables. Row counts indicate typical baseball dataset cardinalities (players ~18k, batting ~101k, fielding ~170k, pitching ~44k).

accepted.name: batting_season_player_agg
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_id,
  year,
  SUM(COALESCE(g,0)) AS g,
  SUM(COALESCE(ab,0)) AS ab,
  SUM(COALESCE(r,0)) AS r,
  SUM(COALESCE(h,0)) AS h,
  SUM(COALESCE("double",0)) AS "double",
  SUM(COALESCE(triple,0)) AS triple,
  SUM(COALESCE(hr,0)) AS hr,
  SUM(COALESCE(rbi,0)) AS rbi,
  SUM(COALESCE(sb,0)) AS sb,
  SUM(COALESCE(cs,0)) AS cs,
  SUM(COALESCE(bb,0)) AS bb,
  SUM(COALESCE(so,0)) AS so
FROM batting
GROUP BY player_id, year
accepted.description: Season-level batting aggregates per player (summed across stints and teams). Useful for player-season leaderboards, rate calculations (AVG, SLG when combined with extra-base breakdowns), and joins to player or team-season records. | Use for: Who led the league in hits/HR/RBI in a given season (after joining to player or team)?; Compute batting averages (h/ab) or rates for players by season; List players with at least N plate appearances (needs ab + bb/hbp if extended)

accepted.name: pitching_season_player_agg
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_id,
  year,
  SUM(COALESCE(w,0)) AS w,
  SUM(COALESCE(l,0)) AS l,
  SUM(COALESCE(g,0)) AS g,
  SUM(COALESCE(gs,0)) AS gs,
  SUM(COALESCE(cg,0)) AS cg,
  SUM(COALESCE(sho,0)) AS sho,
  SUM(COALESCE(sv,0)) AS sv,
  SUM(COALESCE(ipouts,0)) AS ipouts,
  SUM(COALESCE(h,0)) AS h,
  SUM(COALESCE(er,0)) AS er,
  SUM(COALESCE(hr,0)) AS hr,
  SUM(COALESCE(bb,0)) AS bb,
  SUM(COALESCE(so,0)) AS so
FROM pitching
GROUP BY player_id, year
accepted.description: Season-level pitching aggregates per player (summed across stints and teams). Useful for leaderboards (wins, strikeouts), rate metrics (ERA needs ipouts/3 but can be joined), and joining to player or team-season data. | Use for: Who had the most strikeouts/wins in a season?; Compute season ERA approximations (need ipouts->innings) or WHIP when combined with walks; Filter pitchers by workload (games, ipouts) for leaderboards

accepted.name: team_season_summary
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  year,
  league_id,
  team_id,
  franchise_id,
  div_id,
  rank,
  g,
  w,
  l,
  r,
  ab,
  h,
  "double",
  triple,
  hr,
  bb,
  so,
  sb,
  cs,
  era,
  name,
  park,
  team_id_br,
  team_id_lahman45,
  team_id_retro
FROM team
accepted.description: Canonical team-season summary (one row per team in a given year) projecting core measures and identifiers. Useful as the team-side for joins to player-season aggregates, franchise analysis, and season-level comparisons. | Use for: Compare team offensive/defensive totals across seasons; Join with batting_season_player_agg or pitching_season_player_agg to allocate player contributions to team seasons; Filter teams by rank, wins, or playoff wins

accepted.name: player_core
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_id,
  birth_year,
  birth_month,
  birth_day,
  birth_country,
  birth_state,
  birth_city,
  death_year,
  death_month,
  death_day,
  death_country,
  death_state,
  death_city,
  name_first,
  name_last,
  name_given,
  weight,
  height,
  bats,
  throws,
  debut,
  final_game,
  retro_id,
  bbref_id
FROM player
accepted.description: Canonical player reference rows with personal attributes and birth/death details. Use for joins to attach human-readable names and demographic attributes to stats. | Use for: Lookup player biographical info for display alongside stats; Filter players by birth_country/state or debut/final_game ranges; Resolve name-based searches before joining to stats

accepted.name: player_season_above_threshold_cohort
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_id,
  year,
  g,
  ab,
  r,
  h,
  "double",
  triple,
  hr,
  rbi,
  sb,
  cs,
  bb,
  so
FROM batting_season_player_agg
accepted.description: Selectable cohort of player-season rows from batting_season_player_agg that meet an activity threshold (exposes ab and h for downstream rate calc). Keeps threshold out of the CTE; use WHERE when consuming. Useful for filtering to regular players (e.g., minimum plate appearances) before ranking. | Use for: Identify qualified batters for leaderboards (consumer will add WHERE ab>=some_value); Compute batting averages or slugging for a filtered cohort

accepted.name: player_season_rank_by_hits
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_id,
  year,
  h,
  ab,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY COALESCE(h,0) DESC, player_id ASC) AS hits_rank
FROM batting_season_player_agg
accepted.description: Season-level rank of players by hits within each year. Exposes a rank column so callers can filter for Top-K per season by applying WHERE hits_rank <= K. Useful for year-by-year leaderboards and tie-aware ranking. | Use for: Top K hitters by hits per season (apply WHERE hits_rank <= K); Compare ranking positions across seasons

accepted.name: team_franchise_active
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  franchise_id,
  franchise_name,
  active,
  na_assoc
FROM team_franchise
accepted.description: Active franchises (as identified in team_franchise). Useful for filtering analyses to currently active franchises. Keep specific active flag selection outside the CTE if needed. | Use for: List franchises and filter by active='Y' to limit to current franchises; Join to team to show franchise names for team-season rows

accepted.name: player_awards_summary
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_id,
  COUNT(*) AS awards_count,
  MIN(year) AS first_award_year,
  MAX(year) AS last_award_year
FROM player_award
GROUP BY player_id
accepted.description: Aggregate count of awards per player across years (from player_award). Useful to identify multi-award winners, join to player for profiles, or filter for award-winning players. | Use for: Find players with multiple awards or award timelines; Join with player to display award counts alongside biographical info

accepted.name: salary_player_year
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  year,
  team_id,
  league_id,
  player_id,
  salary
FROM salary
accepted.description: Player-season salary facts (one row per player-year-team salary record). Useful to join salary to player-season aggregates or team-season to analyze pay vs performance. | Use for: Join salaries to batting_season_player_agg or pitching_season_player_agg to compute pay per performance; Aggregate payroll by team-season

accepted.name: park_reference
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  park_id,
  park_name,
  park_alias,
  city,
  state,
  country
FROM park
accepted.description: Canonical park reference useful for attaching park names and location to team-season home parks or home_game records. | Use for: Resolve park names and locations for team-season park analysis; Join with home_game to analyze attendance by park
